quarterly_data.quarter: Flex press release: Flex to Acquire EPC Power, Adding Leading Power Conversion (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Operating profile of the EPC Power acquisition (price excluded): EPC Power is expected to generate approximately $800 million of revenue in calendar 2026, with organic revenue growth of approximately 40% expected in 2027 and EBITDA margin expected to expand by double-digit percentage points to approximately 30% in 2027. Flex expects the deal to enhance the growth and EBITDA margin profile of its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment. CEO Revathi Advaithi: EPC brings power conversion and grid-forming technology, 'delivering 800V power conversion today and building towards solid-state transformers'.
quarterly_data.figure: EPC Power revenue approximately $800 million in calendar 2026; approximately 40% organic growth in 2027; EBITDA margin approximately 30% in 2027
